note: BRD4 cohort studies include both prenatal/fetopathological cases and surviving individuals, aligning with model-organism data on lethal neural/cranial defects.

evidence.text: The delineation of BRD4-related syndrome identified 14 patients including two fetuses evaluated by fetopathology alongside surviving pediatric and adult patients.

source.title: Understanding the new BRD4‐related syndrome: Clinical and genomic delineation with an international cohort study
source.quote: We formed an international collaborative study, and collected 14 new patients, including two fetuses. We performed phenotype and genotype analysis, integrated prenatal findings from fetopathological examinations, phenotypes of pediatric patients and adults.

evidence.text: Loss-of-function alterations in Brd4 cause severe prenatal abnormalities and early mortality in developmental models.
